scenario_results.description: default-init dispatches to increase with inlet-valve command active, then slp exactly 0.01 triggers increase-to-hold and neutralizes valves.
scenario_results.name: default_init_increase_then_hold_at_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp above 0.01 enters increase, and increase must not return to hold while slp remains above the boundary.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_increase_then_increase_no_fire_above_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp exactly 0.01 must not take the strict hold-to-increase transition.
scenario_results.name: hold_stays_hold_at_positive_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp below -0.01 enters decrease and commands pressure release, then decrease must not return to hold while slp remains below -0.01.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_decrease_then_decrease_no_fire_below_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp exactly -0.01 must not take the strict hold-to-decrease transition.
scenario_results.name: hold_stays_hold_at_negative_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in decrease with slp exactly -0.01 triggers decrease-to-hold and neutralizes the return valve and pump.
scenario_results.name: decrease_to_hold_at_negative_boundary

evidence: NL: FSM contains states increase, hold, and decrease.
DSL: state increase, state hold, state decrease.
NL/DSL action match: increase sets k1=1,k2=0,n=0; hold sets k1=0,k2=0,n=0; decrease sets k1=0,k2=1,n=500.
NL/DSL guard match: increase->hold [slp <= 0.01], hold->increase [slp > 0.01], hold->decrease [slp < -0.01], decrease->hold [slp >= -0.01].
findings.summary: The discrete FSM components stated in the NL are represented: three states, valve/pump entry actions, and the four threshold transitions.

evidence: NL: 'Wheel speed and vehicle speed are used to compute the slip ratio, and the PID output drives the Stateflow supervisor...'
DSL: only defines slp, k1, k2, n; no wheel-speed, vehicle-speed, or PID state variables.
GroundingMap assumption: continuous computation and PID controller are outside the discrete supervisor model; their output is abstracted as external input slp.
NL: 'continuous wheel-slip dynamics remain in the plant model.'
findings.summary: Wheel speed, vehicle speed, slip-ratio computation, and PID controller dynamics are abstracted into the single input slp. This is acceptable for a discrete supervisor model because the NL says the continuous dynamics remain in the plant model, but the abstraction boundary should remain explicit.
